'''Mason Crawford''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[February 2001 Sioux Falls tournament]] on 25 February 2001, according to Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1805">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-sioux-falls-sd-2-25-00-snow-sucksd1805/ sioux-falls-sd-2-25-00-snow-sucks], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-sioux-falls-sd-2-25-00-snow-sucksd1805/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
